items.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
items.summary: Event sequences are chains of random events, each described by heterogeneous (numerical and categorical) features. The problem of event sequence forecasting occurs in finance, healthcare, business process intelligence, and other fields. In this work, we study multi-horizon forecasting of event sequences as a conditional generative modeling problem. We evaluate forecasts not only for prediction accuracy, but also for distributional realism. items.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as π_{0.5}, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. We introduce MambaAct, an efficient Mamba action expert for flow-matching VLA policies. items.summary: Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed. items.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
items.summary: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. items.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed. Learned unmasking policies improve the speed--accuracy trade-off, yet differ in supervision, inputs, and capacity, obscuring which choices matter. We view supervised policies as distilling a decoding procedure through a teacher and examine independently what the teacher labels as committable, on which states the policy imitates it, what the policy observes, and how much the number of function evaluations (NFE) must decrease to offset policy overhead. items.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. To further improve its practicality, recent budget-controllable FF3DGS methods allow the number of Gaussians to be adjusted at inference, so that the output meets a given storage limit or rendering-latency constraint. items.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
items.summary: Large-scale action pretraining equips Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) with strong manipulation capabilities, with particular strengths in generalization and closed-loop robustness, but reproducing such pretraining requires substantial robot data and computation. To transfer these capabilities from pretrained EFMs to policies without action pretraining, we introduce TILDE (Teacher-In-the-Loop Distillation from EFMs), which synergizes on-policy distillation at student-induced states with learning from teacher-executed recovery trajectories. items.title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
items.summary: LLM routing dynamically selects and coordinates heterogeneous language models across diverse tasks. However, existing approaches are largely built around a predefined execution paradigm, such as single-round, multi-round, or agentic routing, which fixes how model calls are organized and limits adaptation to different query needs. We propose RouteWeaver, a unified routing framework that integrates these routing modes within a single LLM policy, jointly learning which mode to use and how to select models within that mode. items.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
items.summary: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. items.title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
items.summary: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. items.title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
items.summary: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. items.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
items.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. items.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
items.summary: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact. items.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. items.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
items.summary: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. items.title: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
items.summary: Expanding the vocabulary of conditional text-to-speech (TTS) models typically requires extensive fine-tuning with paired audio, creating a major bottleneck for low-resource and cross-lingual adaptation. To address this, we introduce SEAM, a zero-audio initialization method that constructs embeddings for unseen tokens from known subtokens. items.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
items.summary: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection. Existing artifact-based detectors typically identify generation artifacts as evidence for source prediction, yet they may either fail to recognize subtle artifacts or reach the correct source decision without faithfully identifying the evidence underlying it. items.title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
items.summary: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it. We propose Cola2, a framework that jointly studies continuous semantic compression, the balance between reconstruction and generation, and continuous-discrete co-adaptation. items.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
items.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. items.title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
items.summary: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. items.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. items.title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
items.summary: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.summary: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. items.summary: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. items.summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. items.summary: Constructing accurate and computationally tractable approximation spaces is a fundamental task in scientific computing. Partially trainable neural networks bridge fixed random features and fully adaptive representations. This paper quantifies a phase transition pattern in approximation bounds and observes analogous behavior in training errors: a rapid but smooth initial improvement followed by diminishing returns, with a sharper transition under greater initialization mismatch. items.title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
items.summary: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. At each round, the system outputs a proposed decision together with a confidence score estimating the trustworthiness of the decision. The decision and confidence score need not be produced by the same model: for example, one agent may propose a decision, while a separate verifier agent evaluates it and outputs a correctness or safety score. items.title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
items.summary: Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model's generated outputs. items.summary: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. items.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. items.summary: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. items.summary: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. items.summary: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. items.title: 当超算走出实验室：一场从”算得快”到”算得值”的产业迁徙
items.summary: 记者：郭思 编辑：包永刚 导语：超算产业需要更多算力中立供应商 深夜十一点，某新能源汽车企业的仿真计算中心里，屏幕上的流体模拟进度条正在缓缓推进。窗外的城市已经安静下来，但这里的服务器仍在轰鸣——工程师白天做分析、调参数，到了晚上就把计算任务交给算力，第二天一早推开门，结果已经摆在了桌上。 这种“夕发朝看”的工作节奏，正在中国各地的研发实验室里成为新常态。 而与此同时，在内蒙古、宁夏、新疆的广袤土地上，一排排服务器机房亮着指示灯，像沉默的巨人吞吐着数据。这些地方的电费便宜、气候适宜，是部署大规模算力中心的理想之选。但它们不再是过去那种只服务于高校科研的“象牙塔”——越来越多的汽车制造商、大模型企业、航空航天企业、生物医药公司，正在成为这些机房里最活跃的用户。 超算，这个曾经带着浓厚学术色彩的词汇，正在经历一场深刻的产业迁徙。 超算“出圈”：从象牙塔到产业主战场 “五六年前，科研跟高校的场景在我们业务里要超过70%-80%。但到今年，需求更多的是来自企业。”并行科技行业事业部总经理吕昇亮在采访中这样描述行业的巨变。 这个数字背后的驱动力，是各行各业对算力需求的急剧增长。IDC发布的《2026年中国人工智能计算力发展评估报告》预计，2026年中国智能算力规模将达2576.5EFLOPS，同比增长87.9%，到2030年将突破万EFLOPS大关。 面对这一问题，过去，企业要么自建算力集群…

items.title: 从“算力”到“Token 生产力”，硅基流动助力央国企大模型规模化落地
items.summary: 在企业网 D1net 主办的 2026 秋季央国企 CIO 及数科公司高管峰会（第 19 届）上，硅基流动解决方案总监唐安波出席峰会并作主题分享：《从“算力”到“Token 生产力”：央国企大模型规模化落地的推理基础设施与 ROI 实践》。以下为分享内容精华。 当下，AI 应用正处于爆发式增长的早期阶段，Token 消耗量呈指数级增长。这背后，模型架构持续演进，版本更新节奏快速；同时，算力架构也在不断演进。模型与算力之间，是相互推动的迭代过程。对于企业来说，一方面要适配这些变化，另一方面又要面向自己的业务场景提供多元化模型服务，还要把成本控制在合理范围内。 硅基流动在做的事，就是打通从算力到 Token 之间的转化层：把算力统一纳管起来；通过自研推理引擎，让模型跑得更快、更好。我们既在公有云端建设 Token 工厂，也帮助央国企在内部打造自己的 Token 工厂。 简言之，通过系统化的推理工程，做好模型与算力的多重适配。基于此，硅基流动提出 Token 生产力核心公式： Token 生产力 = 产能 × 利用率 × 交付质量 。其中，产能由芯片硬件能力、模型优化水平共同决定；利用率依靠流量治理与算力智能调度实现；交付质量包含模型推理精度、工具调用等任务执行成功率，以及生产环境必备的 SLA 服务稳定性。 从统一纳管到模型运营，把算力利用率真正做起来 我们从业务和流量的视角，设计了四…

items.title: 为什么说奇瑞是一家AI公司？
items.summary: 奇瑞为什么是AI公司？它用AI重造了自己造车的方式，把这层能力做成可复用的底座，并让它长出了汽车之外的新物种。 作者 | 王瑞昊 编辑 | 李雨晨 “ 有几位领导跟我说，感觉奇瑞的汽车越来越不像汽车了，奇瑞也越来越不像一家车企了。这是我想听到的 —— 奇瑞就是一家「披着汽车企业马甲」的高科技创新企业。 ” 10 月 20 日， 2026 奇瑞全球创新大会在安徽芜湖开幕。说出这句话的，是做了四十多年汽车的奇瑞汽车董事长尹同跃。一个把大半辈子交给汽车的人，主动摘掉 “ 车企 ” 这块招牌，不是自谦，是判断。 他的依据是一个隐喻： 1886 年，奔驰造出第一台汽车，被时代抛下的，是那些一辈子赶马车的养马人，他们没做错什么，只是没看见路已经变了。 “ 真正的风险不是 AI 太强太快，而是我们不能继续做当年的养马人。 ” 尹同跃说， “ 未来 AI 真正淘汰的，是拒绝 AI 、不敢用 AI 的企业。 ” 所以奇瑞的选择很直白：刀口向内，主动用 AI 给自己做一场基因重组，先改变自己，再改变世界。 雷峰网认为，判断奇瑞是不是 AI 公司，不能看它发布会上喊了多少次 AI ，要看三件事： AI 有没有重构它的生产流程，有没有沉淀为可复用的统一底座，有没有在汽车之外长出新的物种。 PART 1 从CheryMind到紫微芯片 奇瑞把30年造车经验炼成了AI底座 市面上的通用大模型像一本百科全书，什…

items.title: 擦窗机器人有了首个行业标准，你敢把窗户交给它吗？

items.title: iPhone Duo开售，美团闪购：最早一单20分钟送达
items.summary: 北京时间今日早晨八点，iPhone Duo正式发售。作为Apple推出的首款折叠屏产品，消费者的热情使眼下的iPhone Duo可谓“一机难求”：早在一周前开启预售时，多个渠道就迅速售罄，苹果官网也因为流量过大一度卡顿。当前官网显示，iPhone Duo的预计交付时间已排至明年1月，二手市场溢价更令人望而却步。 在这一情况下，不少消费者开始尝试通过各类新渠道“打新”。记者在社交平台注意到，随着各大平台深入布局新品首发，即时零售在今年意外成为不少消费者抢购新品的新渠道。有消费者晒出自己在美团闪购成功抢到iPhone Duo的经历，称“闪购是今年抢到首发的惊喜”。记者从美团闪购方面获悉，本次iPhone新品通过平台上300多个城市的Apple授权专营店首发，预售销量创下新高。今日iPhone Duo正式发售后，最快一单仅用时20分钟，即由美团骑手送至南通市崇川区的一位消费者手中。 ▲美团骑手在Apple授权店取货（摄影：祝立明） “闪购是今年抢到首发的惊喜”，这背后是新的消费习惯在产生。艾瑞咨询发布的《即时零售消费电子行业白皮书》显示，从2021年至2026年，电子品类消费在即时零售市场的年复合增长率预计达到68.5%，在高速增长的市场驱动下，即时零售已成为品牌发售新品的必争之地。

items.title: 国外的天空是否很清澈
items.summary: 刚出社会那前几年，年轻有力，想到处跑来玩，旅游。 各种吃喝玩乐，熬夜看日出，见过国内大部分城市华灯初上，纸醉金迷的画面。 什么北京，两湖，两广，云南，贵州等等很多大省都去过。 但是现在感觉好像没有太多的感觉了？再见已是同样的风格，山水亦是记忆重播。 国内倡导大家旅游，各省会跑，提高人均消费，但是殊不知，很多时候去的地方，其实都是期待过高，然后实际就一般。吃的也是，再也没有新奇感，所以是我老了见识多了，还是已经玩腻国内了？ 不知道有没有人和我感觉一样，感觉外面的天空可能会清澈。。

items.title: 大家会记得很久之前发生的事情吗？
items.summary: 去年和喜欢的小学同桌恢复了联系，闲聊时我提到咱两坐同桌那会发生了什么，她说：“咱两没坐过同桌”，我很诧异，我俩小学四年级可是做了一学期同桌的，怎么会没有呢？ 转念一想，可能我对她并不重要，人们只会记住自己在意的事情，也很正常。 我对关于她的事情记得很清楚，到现在还清晰记得小学某个周末我专程去给她送试卷，她妈妈笑着迎接我，戴的眼镜上挂着一条银色的链子，闪闪发光。 --- 最近和两个女性朋友聊了关于感情的话题，无一例外都说自己将几年前恋爱的事情忘记了，只记得自己分手时很伤心也挽留过，但对面的长相、怎么认识的、甚至连名字都已经模糊不清了，也不是不记得，真的就是忘记了这些事情。 我有点诧异，可能是我记性太好，我对很久之前的事情尤其是爱慕之人相关的事情记得非常清晰，这种刻骨铭心的感觉怎么会忘记呢？到死大概也不会忘。 她们为什么会忘记呢？ 是因为太过痛苦，然后大脑下意识地消除、遮蔽了这方面的记忆，来逃避痛苦吗？

items.summary: 请教各位大佬个事，我现在这算传统行业，目前也算个管理层，在深圳年收入 30 多万，不高不低，但 2 年前新业务线老板过来以后，我已经算被架空了，重要管理层会议基本没我份（由我直接上级参会），目前一亩三分地依然负责不变，但我不用汇报给业务线老板了，每次季度大型会议总是觉得屈辱，自我内耗想跳槽，但实话说，我现在 base 远离业务总部，也就是我现在其实居家办公，远程打个卡报道，日常在家边工作边带娃，工资绩效也不变，算是非常非常舒服的工作，而且跳槽外面行情也一般，说不定跳完以后工作更辛苦工资收入反而拿不到目前水平，有时候想想未来又觉得自己这样边缘化下去浪费时间没有成长，年龄一到估计就拿 N+1 了，也考虑过就这样下去，实在到 N+1 了就去送外卖也可以
